name: pool-maintenance
//: The declared pool maintenance's budget domain: its budgets.yaml and the measurement only that budget runs. The measurement builds the workspace twice, so its only budget target is `budgets-host`, which `check`, `check-affected` and the root budgets never select; `just budgets-host` runs it on the release PR. `bootstrap` installs the pinned pruner the `pool-maintenance` recipe runs.
